# BTicino C300X Integration v2.1.3

## 2026-11-13

This release gives the native display's pages their own dialog. Pages get a
name, a position and their entities in one place, so they can be ordered and
filled without page names typed per entity.

The native agent and the display files are unchanged; the device needs no
update.

## Pages Dialog

- The dashboard settings lead to a pages dialog with up to 8 pages, the status
  page included. Each page has a **Name**, a **Position** and its
  **Entities**, which appear in the order they are picked and can be dragged
  into a new order.
- Pages are shown by position, lowest first. The status page, with the HA,
  alarm and time badges and the weather card, can be moved like any other.
- A page name and an entity can each be used once, and `C300X`, the status
  page's internal name, is reserved. An error is shown on the page it
  concerns.
- An existing entry opens the dialog with its current pages: the status page
  first, the others in the order they appeared so far, 10 apart. Entities
  without a page name keep their untitled page until it is named or emptied.

## Changed

- The entity-display dialog sets tile width and height, name and secondary
  line. **Page** and **Position** moved to the pages dialog.
- The weather card always heads the status page. **Weather - Page** and
  **Weather - Position** are gone, and a placement saved with 2.1.2 is
  dropped.

## Fixed

- Entities without a page name no longer end up on a separate untitled page
  that could not be named or ordered, and pages no longer follow the order
  their names first appear in.

## Upgrade

- Update the integration; no agent update and no Display patch change are
  needed. Home Assistant 2026.7 remains the minimum, and existing entries keep
  their pages.

## Validation

- The release ran the full local and CI validation gates. The pages form is
  checked as Home Assistant serializes it for the frontend; it was not tried in
  a live Home Assistant UI or on a physical C300X.
